verdict.rationale: Only community comments show that Milvus offers several index types: FAISS-based IVF indices, a GPU-accelerated IVF_SQ8H, other IVF variants and disk-based search. That implies a user can choose among indexes with different performance profiles. There is no first-party documentation of HNSW graph settings, index build or search parameters, or guidance on trading recall against latency and memory. missing for 10: first-party index-type documentation, HNSW parameter tuning (M/efConstruction/ef), search-time parameter controls, documented recall/latency/memory trade-off guidance, hands-on tuning corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can tune index parameters (HNSW graph settings, index types) to trade recall against latency and memory

citations.quote: IVF_SQ8H reconstructs Faiss IVF SQ8 with much better performance but requires a GPU.
if you want hybrid search, different IVF variants, disk-based search, horizontal scaling, SIMD, or sparse vectors, Milvus is great.
